_comment: Curated source for the Sennyu-ji (泉涌寺) calendar. build.js reads this and generates data.json for the rolling 6-month window. Edit the 'dated' entries when the temple announces new dates (autumn light-ups, OTOBUTAI editions, foliage). recurringMonthly / annualFixed / annualNthWeekday regenerate automatically every year.

annualNthWeekday.nt: Flagship autumn ritual (3rd Sunday of October): ~300-person procession across a 50m bridge, from 13:00.
Coming-of-Age Day (2nd Monday of January): 9 sub-temples, 8:00-16:00. Busiest winter day.

dated.nt: Produced evening performance (doors 17:30, start 18:30). Grounds given over to the production that evening.
